items.feature: §76.8 reconciliation operator console: pending observations with one bounded suggested action each (reconcile / renew / submit); no direct database edits

§76.10 mission learning records: each accepted contribution classified against the declared node verdict (contradicts / confirmed / new evidence / inconclusive); decision changes recorded only by an explicit requester statement; no impact score
§76.4 offer amendment negotiation: counteroffers as new terms revisions with schema-classified consequential differences and explicit supersession (delivered in Group A/B)
§76.5 honest-negative templates: determination, infeasibility_witness, independent_replay, diagnostic_delivery with runnable examples (journeys 1, 9, 11, 12, 32)

§76.1 repeated procurement programs: a bounded recurring class of work with per-run and aggregate ceilings and a run limit; every run freezes new terms on fresh inputs (reused input digests refused) and opens a fresh request; the aggregate is enforced inside the award transaction

§76.3 verifier challenge packages: a receipt recipient proposes a bounded counterexample (own inputs, asserted outcome) executed as an ordinary job on the challenger's behalf without reading the contract's private evidence; signed package; attachable to a dispute
items.entry_points: POST /work/receipts/{id}/challenge, GET /work/challenges[/{id}[/package]], dispute evidence {challenge_id}; CLI work-challenge*

items.feature: §76.7 versioned pricing experiments: fixed vs metered policies over a declared synthetic outcome workload under the frozen payment rule; stored and versioned; quotes, terms and the journal untouched
